cases.case_label: Alu insertion in intron 1 of SLC17A8
cases.disease: Progressive sensorineural hearing loss (autosomal dominant family history)
cases.mechanism_detail: A heterozygous Alu insertion (15-bp TSD, polyA tail) in intron 1 of SLC17A8, absent from gnomAD-SV, was found by WGS in a proband with progressive high-frequency SNHL consistent with SLC17A8-associated hearing loss; functional contribution not tested.
cases.quote: whether this Alu insertion in the SLC17A8 gene functionally contributes to the disease requires further investigation
